name: Ardhi

lines.text: You have come from the spring. Everybody does, eventually, and asks me why it is not where the survey puts it. I say the survey is correct. I have been saying it for nineteen years.
Every post-hole on the plateau is in the survey, and every one was dug after the road. Nothing goes up on University ground that the survey has not seen.
I keep the ground book. The archive keeps what happened; I keep where it is allowed to happen. It is less interesting and I prefer it.
Before the first entry. -- Nineteen years, and I never once asked what the first page was written after.

notes: Drafted 27 September 2026 for the owner to rewrite. The Narmada's thesis is a record that begins at the wound. She trusts the survey the way other people trust ground, and is not wrong to -- it is perfect -- only about where it starts.
